title: Invis Cushion
description: Makes the Cushion texture fully transparent
body:
Transparent Cushion is a simple vanilla resource pack that makes every Cushion texture fully transparent.

The pack only changes the appearance of Cushions and does not affect their functionality, models, or any other Minecraft textures. This makes it compatible with most other resource packs as long as they don't modify the same textures.
